notes.title: News!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone, here are some cute pictures while you waiting for the release of the game!
If you do not collect half of the carrots on a level, the bunny will be very sad![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019077/2e20d15e578f977bc0067b6f855c4088ab3b607a.jpg[/img]
[h3] You can't upset the bunny.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019077/a65c332736175fb6e2f9b9d2896a02096ce90299.jpg[/img]
[h3] We also added icons to select difficulty levels in the game.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019077/0e44c4cc93da2d50e942498db2a13aabe5c6f967.jpg[/img]
